package.name: rs_follow_core
package.description:
Framework-independent RoboSense 3D LiDAR person-following algorithm.
Contains no ROS dependency at all: it builds with a bare g++ -std=c++17 and can be linked into a non-ROS upper-computer program, bound to Python, or wrapped by the rs_follow ROS 2 node (which is now a thin adapter).
